pieces.title: The Menu, Week 4
pieces.dek: Three starting quarterbacks and five lead backs are off the menu, Kenneth Walker III is RB3, Jaylen Warren is a top-10 back on Thursday night, and Jayden Daniels sits outside the top 24 until he practices.

pieces.title: Market Run, Week 4
pieces.dek: Ollie Gordon II is the only Miami back standing after Achane's ACL, and he is the first name on this week's list.

pieces.title: Heat Check, Week 4
pieces.dek: Rashee Rice went from 2 targets to 6 to 9. The Kansas City passing game is his again.

pieces.title: Butcher Shop, Week 4
pieces.dek: Chris Olave has 36 targets and one touchdown. That price will not last, so go get him today.
